entities.note: 5x5 two-tone square at rows 45-49, cols 34-38 (top 2 rows colour 12, bottom 3 rows colour 9) near the bottom of the maze; moves one 5-px cell per press on a lattice of cells at rows 5j, cols 4+5k

colour-3 corridors: a wide room rows 25-39 cols 14-53 with a colour-4 pillar at cols 29-33 rows 30-39, a vertical passage cols 34-38 rows 8-24 up to the pad, a lower room rows 40-49 cols 34-53, a stub cols 19-23 rows 40-49 joining the start row rows 45-49 cols 19-53
colour 4 fills everything that is not corridor, HUD or frame (rows 0-59); a move into it is refused

a 5-px black/colour-1 arrow glyph (pixels (31,21)=0, (32,20)=1, (32,21)=0, (32,22)=0, (33,21)=1) in the floor cell rows 30-34, cols 19-23; stepping onto that cell rotates the carried shape by 90 degrees; it stays and can be used again

the goal pad at the top of the vertical passage: 7x7 colour-5 square rows 9-15, cols 33-39 (inside a colour-3 border rows 8-16, cols 32-40) showing the 3x3 colour-9 goal glyph at rows 11-13, cols 35-37 (pixels (11,35),(11,36),(11,37),(12,37),(13,35),(13,37)); the player must step onto its centre cell (rows 10-14, cols 34-38) while carrying the same glyph in the same orientation

10x10 colour-5 box at rows 53-62, cols 1-11 (bottom-left) displaying the carried shape at 2x scale in colour 9 (rows 55-60, cols 3-8): the goal glyph rotated 270 degrees on the first frame (rows 55-56 full, then only cols 3-4, then cols 3-4 and 7-8); it flashes black when the pad refuses entry
colour-5 strip down cols 0-3 (rows 0-51) and strips along rows 60 and 63 framing the HUD
rows 61-62, cols 13-54: 42 one-pixel-wide colour-11 cells = remaining steps, turning colour 3 from the LEFT one per action (blocked moves included); empty = lose a life and the level resets
three 2x2 colour-8 marks at rows 61-62, cols 56-57, 59-60, 62-63: lives; one is lost each time the step bar empties, at zero the game is over

rules.note: a move into colour 4 is refused; the step is still spent (same for ACTION2/3/4)

the move that enters the rotator's cell turns the carried shape 90 degrees (270 -> 0 here, so ONE pass makes it match the pad) and the HUD glyph is redrawn; the player also moves onto the cell (same for ACTION2/3/4); crossing it again keeps rotating

entering the pad's centre cell while the carried glyph does not match the pad's glyph is refused and the HUD box flashes black for 5 frames; the step is still spent; with a matching glyph the move succeeds and the level ends
ACTION5/6/7 are not offered; if sent they do nothing and cost nothing

goal.note: the player must step onto the pad's centre cell (rows 10-14, cols 34-38) while the HUD glyph equals the pad glyph (same shape, colour 9, rotation 0): cross the rotator once (270 -> 0) then walk to the pad; minimal 13 moves (3 left, 3 up, 1 up onto the rotator, 3 right, 3 up)

budget.note: when the 42 steps run out one of the 3 lives (lives8) is removed, the player and carried shape are reset to the start and the bar refills; the game is lost when the last life goes
